tagline: A Chao Phraya riverside town that blends seamlessly into Bangkok
introHtml:
Nonthaburi sits right on Bangkok's northern edge. Hop on the Purple Line train or the Chao Phraya Express Boat and you're there. Most people know it as a residential city, but there's plenty of riverside sights and old markets tucked away.

The highlight is Koh Kret, an island in the middle of the river with a Mon community, pottery, and street food you can graze on all day. It's perfect for a there-and-back day trip from Bangkok.
bestTime: November–February, cool and comfortable — good for walking the riverside markets all day

highlights.name: Koh Kret
highlights.blurb: An island in the Chao Phraya with a Mon community, old temples, pottery, and street food to graze on

highlights.name: Wat Chaloem Phra Kiat Worawihan
highlights.blurb: A riverside temple with handsome Rama III-era architecture, not far from the town center

highlights.name: Tha Nam Nonthaburi
highlights.blurb: An old riverside quarter with markets, food, and an express-boat pier linking to Bangkok

highlights.name: Purple Line MRT
highlights.blurb: Connects Nonthaburi to Bangkok easily, making a quick there-and-back day trip simple

highlights.name: Sai Noi Floating Market
highlights.blurb: A local-feeling floating market in Sai Noi district with cheap, homestyle food

highlights.name: Somdet Phra Sri Nakarin Park, Nonthaburi
highlights.blurb: A riverside public park with green space for strolling and cycling

foodScene.name: Tod Man Nor Kala
foodScene.note: A Koh Kret specialty — fish cakes made with nor kala, a local plant that's hard to find elsewhere

foodScene.name: Mon sweets
foodScene.note: Thai-Mon desserts on Koh Kret, from thong yip to khanom kong and other old-style sweets

foodScene.name: Nonthaburi durian
foodScene.note: Local Nonthaburi durian cultivars known for their flesh and their price — look for them in durian season

foodScene.name: Boat noodles (kuay teow ruea)
foodScene.note: Long-running boat-noodle shops are scattered across town, rich and full-flavored

foodScene.name: Chao Phraya riverside dining
foodScene.note: Restaurants and cafes along the river where you can eat and watch the boats pass at dusk

foodScene.name: Tha Nam Nonthaburi street food
foodScene.note: Grazing food around the pier and old market at local prices

foodScene.name: Riverside cafes
foodScene.note: Several river-view cafes around Koh Kret and along the Chao Phraya

attractions.name: Koh Kret
attractions.blurb: A Mon community island — walk the temples, browse the pottery, and sample food around the island

attractions.name: Wat Chaloem Phra Kiat Worawihan
attractions.blurb: A riverside temple blending Chinese and Thai architecture from the Rama III era

attractions.name: Wat Poramai Yikawat
attractions.blurb: An old Mon temple on Koh Kret with a Mon-style chedi and a reclining Buddha

attractions.name: Sai Noi Floating Market
attractions.blurb: A laid-back local floating market with homestyle food

attractions.name: Somdet Phra Sri Nakarin Park, Nonthaburi
attractions.blurb: A riverside public park for strolling and cycling

attractions.name: Tha Nam Nonthaburi and the old quarter
attractions.blurb: A Chao Phraya riverside quarter with markets, old buildings, and an express-boat pier
